name: wechat-analyzer-codex
description: Codex plugin for exporting WeChat chats and generating the local portrait report in this repository.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze local WeChat chats and generate the portrait report
interface.longDescription: A Codex-ready plugin that exports local WeChat contact chats, prepares personality analysis inputs, writes structured result JSON, and renders the final HTML portrait report for this repository.
defaultPrompt: Use $analyze-wechat to analyze my chat history with a WeChat contact.
Use $analyze-wechat to continue a prepared WeChat CSV analysis.
Use $analyze-wechat to generate the final WeChat portrait report.
